test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: B and C can complete a work alone in 10 days and 30 days respectively. They began the work together but B left the work after some days and C completed the remaining work in 10 days. After how many days from the beginning B left the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by B = 10 days

Time taken by C = 30 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency x Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10 and 30 = 30.

Let the total work be 30 units

Efficiency of B = 30/10 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of C = 30/30 = 1 unit/day

Let B and C work for x days together, after that B left and C will complete the remaining work in 10 days.

⇒ (3 + 1)x + 1 × 10 = 30

⇒ 4x = 30 - 10

⇒ 4x = 20

⇒ x = 20/4 = 5

**After 5 days from the beginning B will leave the work.**
